e-pro-privacy-and-abilities.1.evidence: Core personal-data exporters for maya run with done=true and produce groups 'Jetonomy Pro: Private Messages' (2 items), 'Jetonomy Pro: Reactions' (5), 'Jetonomy Pro: Badges' (9), 'Jetonomy Pro: Poll Votes' (2) alongside Free groups; maya has no push subscription or custom-field values so those exporters returned no group (run in-process via eval, not the Tools screen).

e-pro-privacy-and-abilities.9.evidence: `wp_get_abilities()` lists 42 abilities (Free 19 incl. jetonomy/moderate-content; Pro: send-message, list-conversations, get-conversation, get-analytics, export-analytics, create-poll, vote-poll, get-poll-results, list-badges, get-user-badges, award-badge, list-webhooks, create-webhook, ...). The check expects reactions and custom-fields abilities too; none with those names are registered. Likely an out-of-date check line or missing abilities - main session to decide.
